headline: Namibia President Endorses $2.5 Billion Dangote Energy Project
summary: Namibian President Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah has designated the $2.5 billion Dangote Namibia Tank Farm and Regional Pipeline Project as a key investment for regional industrialization and energy security.
why: Large-scale energy infrastructure projects are critical for regional economic integration and can significantly impact the energy supply chain in Southern Africa.
